text: Environmental DNA (eDNA) 12S metabarcoding Illumina MiSeq NGS PCR Protocol

payload.title: Environmental DNA (eDNA) 12S metabarcoding Illumina MiSeq NGS PCR Protocol

text: PCR reactions for 12S were performed with a two-step amplification protocol for each sample using the MiFish U primers (Miya et al., 2015).

payload.text: PCR reactions for 12S were performed with a two-step amplification protocol for each sample using the MiFish U primers (Miya et al., 2015).

text: The primary PCR amplifications were carried out in triplicate 20 ul reactions using: 2ul gDNA extract template (1:10 dilution) 10 ul Hotstar MasterMix (2X) (Qiagen, USA)

payload.text: The primary PCR amplifications were carried out in triplicate 20 ul reactions using: 2ul gDNA extract template (1:10 dilution) 10 ul Hotstar MasterMix (2X) (Qiagen, USA)

text: 8 ul of each untagged forward and reverse primer (10 uM)

payload.text: 8 ul of each untagged forward and reverse primer (10 uM)

text: PCR reactions were performed in 8-well strip tubes with a no template control (NTC) for each group of environmental sample triplicates and artificial community as a positive control per amplification round using the 12S primary PCR primers below (all primers listed in 5’ to 3’ direction).12S MiFish U (forward): GTC GGT AAA ACT CGT GCC AGC12S MiFish U (reverse): CAT AGT GGG GTA TCT AAT CCC AGT TTG

text: Secondary PCR amplifications are conducted in triplicate 20 ul reactions using same reaction master mix as primary PCR, but with 0.8 ul of each tagged 12S forward and reverse primer (10 uM) listed below (forward & reverse with matching unique 6-base tag, indicated by Xs). 12S (forward): NNN XXX XXX GTC GGT AAA ACT CGT GCC AGC12S (reverse): NNN XXX XXX CAT AGT GGG GTA TCT AAT CCC AGT TTG

text: The reaction is carried through with 2 ul of each purified environmental as well as positive and NTC samples.

text: Secondary 12S tagged PCR cycling parameters: 95 °C for 5 minutes Twenty cycles of 95 °C for 15 seconds 57 °C for 30 seconds 72 °C for 30 seconds Held at 4 °C Quality control, PCR clean-up

text: After PCR amplification of the marker region, the pooled PCR products were run through an agarose gel to confirm the presence of target bands and absense of non-specific amplification across environmental samples as well as the absence of amplification in no-template controls (NTCs).

text: PCR products were purified and size selected using the Agencourt AMPure XP bead system (Beckman Coulter, USA).

text: A second agarose gel was run to confirm primer removal and retention of target amplicons after purification.

text: Purified products were then quantified using Quant-It Picogreen dsDNA Assay (Life Technologies) on an fmax Molecular Devices Fluorometer with a Qubit dsDNA HS kit.

text: Equimolar pools were constructed and quantified with Qubit dsDNA HS kit to confirm pool concentration prior to library preparation.
